plugins.description: Turn a requirement into work in three steps that share one ID scheme and one check script: analyze-requirements compares a requirement with its previous version and the code, checks it against the DoD, and settles every unclear point with the PO through one DoU file, giving system requirements; derive-software-requirements derives testable software requirements from the final analysis; group-epics groups them into epics. Reads files and writes Markdown in a topic folder; never changes code.
